entries.title: A task's progress moves while its crewmate works
entries.body: Crewmates often marked their plan only when they started and when they finished, so a task's Progress row could sit on its first step for most of the work. Crewmates now mark each step as it finishes.
entries.noPicture: The Progress row looks the same; the change is that its dots move during the work instead of at the end.
